title: Neuron
definition: The neuron is the basic structural and functional unit of the nervous system.
description: Nerve cells receive, carry, and pass on information throughout the body.
think_prompt: What is the basic unit of the nervous system?
quick_check: What is the name of the specialized cell that carries nerve impulses?

title: Structure of a neuron
definition: A neuron is made of a cell body, dendrites, and an axon.
description: These structures allow it to receive and transmit information.
think_prompt: Which part of a neuron receives information?
quick_check: Name the main structures of a neuron.

title: Three neuron types
definition: There are sensory, motor, and interneurons in the nervous system.
description: Each type has a specific role in detecting, coordinating, and responding to signals.
think_prompt: How are neurons different from each other?
quick_check: Name the three main neuron types.
